_about: Sector vocabulary packs (Signal Intelligence refinement). DATA ONLY: each pack lists specific technology terms and the existing Otech capability they evidence. commercial/capabilities.py merges every pack into the catalogue's `keywords` at load time, for every account -- there is no sector detection and no organization name anywhere. A term listed here is treated exactly like any other specific catalogue keyword: it can only strengthen evidence through the existing evidence rules (account association, a locally grounded technology/procurement event, industry-context and LinkedIn guards). Add a pack, or terms to a pack, without touching code.

packs.description: Operational-technology / IoT sensing and messaging systems (any sector).
